CheckTitle: IAM roles trusting GitHub Actions OIDC restrict the subject claim
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Description: IAM roles that trust the GitHub Actions OIDC provider must constrain the `token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub` claim to a specific repository owner.
Risk: Without a repository-owner constraint, workflows from unauthorized GitHub repositories may assume the role and access AWS resources.

Code.Other: Add a strict condition for token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub, such as repo:ORG/REPOSITORY:ref:refs/heads/main.

Recommendation.Text: Restrict GitHub Actions OIDC trust to repositories and owners that your organization controls.

Notes: Roles without a GitHub Actions OIDC federated trust statement are outside the scope of this check.
